title: Beranda
text: SecurePayload v3.2.0 Kirim data antar-server dengan aman Tidak bisa diubah, tidak bisa dibaca orang lain, tidak bisa diputar ulang. Mulai dalam 10 menit Pahami dulu konsepnya Tiga perlindungan 1 Pemalsuan Segel digital rusak jika isi diubah. 2 Penyadapan Isi dikunci (AEAD) di mode aead/both. 3 Replay Tiket sekali pakai + buku daftar. Pilih jalur belajar A Saya ingin paham dulu Konsep tanpa kode. Mulai → B Saya developer Instalasi → Mulai cepat. Mulai → C Saya ops/keamanan Peringatan & checklist. Mulai → Siapa yang cocok? API server-to-server, webhook masuk, atau klien yang harus membuktikan identitas dengan kunci bersama atau Ed25519. ! Kapan tidak Bukan pengganti login pengguna akhir atau OAuth penuh. Mode hmac tidak mengenkripsi. Status Library v3.2.0 · protokol default 4 PHP CI-tested 8.0–8.5 · lisensi MIT Belum ada audit keamanan pihak ketiga GitHub · Packagist sk8dvlpr/securepayload

title: Konsep Dasar
text: Anda akan belajar tiga risiko dan cara SecurePayload menjaganya dengan analogi sederhana. Masalah yang dipecahkan Pemalsuan — orang mengubah body di tengah jalan. Penyadapan — orang membaca isi rahasia. Replay — orang mengirim ulang pesan sah. Analogi tetap Amplop bersegel = tanda tangan digital (HMAC / Ed25519). Amplop terkunci = enkripsi AEAD (XChaCha20-Poly1305). Tiket bernomor sekali pakai + tanggal = nonce + timestamp. Buku daftar tiket = replay store. Brankas kunci = KMS. Tiga mode Mode Arti ramah Kode Tanda tangan saja Segel, isi masih bisa dibaca hmac Kunci saja Isi terkunci, tanpa segel HMAC terpisah aead Keduanya Terkunci + tersegel (disarankan) both Alur singkat Klien membangun header keamanan + body → server memverifikasi dari method/path/query miliknya sendiri → menolak jika segel rusak, kunci gagal, atau tiket sudah dipakai. ‼ Penting Jangan percaya header X-Canonical-Request untuk verifikasi. Itu hanya petunjuk debug. Selanjutnya: Pilih Mode →

title: Pilih Mode
text: Jawab empat pertanyaan. Hasilnya merekomendasikan mode dan algoritma tanda tangan. Apakah isi data rahasia? Ya, harus dikunci Tidak, cukup segel Apakah penerima boleh menyimpan kunci yang sama? Ya, shared secret OK Tidak, lebih suka kunci publik Perlu bukti pengirim (non-repudiation)? Ya, Ed25519 Tidak perlu Ada banyak server di belakang load balancer? Ya Tidak / satu host Rekomendasi Mode: Tanda tangan (signAlg): Karena ada load balancer, setel replayStore terpusat dan pertimbangkan requireReplayStore . Instalasi → Ulangi Perbandingan singkat Mode Manfaat Perlu hmac Segel saja HMAC ≥32 chars aead Kunci saja AEAD 32-byte + sodium both Segel + kunci Keduanya i signAlg hmac | ed25519 | hybrid-mldsa44-ed25519 — ditentukan konfigurasi server (anti-downgrade). Lanjutan ed25519 , hybrid PQ, deriveKeys , bindHeaders — lihat halaman Fitur.

title: Instalasi
text: Anda akan memasang library dan mengecek ekstensi yang dibutuhkan. Kebutuhan PHP ≥ 8.0 (CI menguji 8.0–8.5) ext-json , ext-hash ext-sodium wajib untuk mode aead / both dan Ed25519 Opsional: ext-curl , PSR-18, PSR-16, SDK KMS cloud Cek di mesin Anda bash Salin php -v php -m | findstr sodium Pasang lewat Composer bash Salin composer require sk8dvlpr/securepayload Jika berhasil, paket muncul di vendor/sk8dvlpr/securepayload . ✓ Tips Hybrid ML-DSA membutuhkan pqSigner dari aplikasi Anda — tidak dibundle. Selanjutnya: Mulai Cepat →

title: Mulai Cepat
text: Target: request both berhasil dalam ≤ 10 menit. Kunci di bawah hanya untuk uji. Buat kunci uji HMAC ≥ 32 karakter; AEAD tepat 32 byte (base64). Sisi pengirim buildHeadersAndBody. Sisi penerima verify dengan method/path/query server. Kirim request Header X-* + body. Uji rusak Ubah body → harus ditolak. Contoh klien php Salin <?php use SecurePayload\SecurePayload; // TEST keys only — never use in production $hmac = str_repeat('a', 32); $aead = base64_encode(random_bytes(32)); $sp = new SecurePayload([ 'mode' => 'both', 'clientId' => 'demo', 'keyId' => 'v1', 'hmacSecretRaw' => $hmac, 'aeadKeyB64' => $aead, ]); [$headers, $body] = $sp->buildHeadersAndBody( 'https://example.test/api/orders', 'POST', ['orderId' => 1] ); Contoh server php Salin <?php $sp = new SecurePayload([ 'mode' => 'both', 'keyLoader' => function ($cid, $kid) use ($hmac, $aead) { return ['hmacSecret' => $hmac, 'aeadKeyB64' => $aead]; }, // multi-server: inject replayStore + requireReplayStore ]); $result = $sp-&g

title: Mengelola Kunci
text: Cara membuat kunci HMAC secret: minimal 32 karakter . AEAD key: tepat 32 byte , disimpan sebagai base64. Ed25519: pasangan kunci; request memakai pasangan klien ; response memakai pasangan server . bash Salin composer exec securepayload keys:generate Tempat menyimpan Env ( EnvKeyProvider ), database ( DbKeyProvider ), atau brankas KMS . ‼ Jangan Jangan commit kunci ke git, jangan kirim lewat chat, jangan log secret. Rotasi KeyManager::rotateKey() / CLI keys:rotate mendukung masa tenggang ( useKeyLifecycle ). ! LocalKms Hanya untuk pengembangan. Produksi: Vault/AWS/GCP/Azure. Selanjutnya: Fitur →

title: Fitur & Manfaat
text: Pilih fitur. Setiap halaman memakai template manfaat → kapan → cara → API. Anti-replay — Melindungi dari pesan sah yang dikirim ulang. Response Dua Arah — Server membalas dengan segel yang terikat ke nonce request. File Kecil — Kirim lampiran kecil di JSON (_attachment). File Streaming — Streaming secretstream per-chunk untuk file besar. File Multipart — Manifest aman + ciphertext dalam satu request multipart (wire v4). Webhook — Verifikasi webhook masuk dengan aturan yang sama. Ed25519 — Tanda tangan asimetris: klien private, server public. Hybrid Pasca-kuantum — Hybrid ML-DSA44 + Ed25519 untuk persiapan pasca-kuantum. deriveKeys — HKDF menurunkan subkey per fungsi dari master key. bindHeaders — Ikat header kritis ke AAD agar tidak bisa diganti diam-diam. Observability — Callback onSecurityEvent + Prometheus/OTel exporter. RFC 9421 — Jembatan interop ke HTTP Message Signatures. SDK Node & Go — SDK Node.js & Go mengikuti wire protocol (default 4). CLI — CLI untuk generate/rotate keys dan debug. mTLS — mTLS melengkapi SecurePayload di lapisan transport. KMS — Brankas kunci: Local, Vault, AWS, GCP, Azure. Penyimpanan File — Pola simpan & kirim file setelah verifikasi aman

title: Peringatan
text: Wajib / Do ⛔ Samakan versi protokol di klien & server (default 4). ⛔ Server wajib memakai method/path/query dari request sendiri. ⛔ Multi-server: replayStore terpusat + requireReplayStore . ⛔ HTTPS di produksi. ⚠️ HMAC ≥ 32 chars; AEAD 32 byte. ⚠️ deriveKeys dan bindHeaders harus sama di kedua sisi. 💡 Response mengikuti signAlg — bukan selalu HMAC. Jangan / Don't ⛔ Jangan percaya X-Canonical-Request untuk verifikasi. ⛔ Jangan simpan private Ed25519 request di server. ⛔ Jangan log secret / plaintext. ⚠️ Jangan andalkan cache file bawaan di belakang load balancer. ⚠️ Jangan pakai LocalKms di produksi. 💡 Jangan anggap library sudah diaudit pihak ketiga — belum. Daftar periksa produksi Centang disimpan di browser (localStorage) bila tersedia. Protocol version sama di kedua sisi HTTPS wajib replayStore terpusat jika multi-server requireReplayStore diaktifkan di multi-server Kunci dari env/KMS, bukan hardcode signAlg ditetapkan di server Tim paham belum ada audit pihak ketiga Reset checklist i Default replayTtl=120, clockSkew=60. Jendela memori nonce = replayTtl + clockSkew. Selanjutnya: Troubleshooting →

title: Pemecahan Masalah
text: Gejala → perbaikan Symptom Meaning Likely cause Fix 401 / tanda tangan invalid Segel tidak cocok Secret beda / body berubah / path beda Samakan kunci; cek method/path/query 401 / replay detected Tiket sudah dipakai Request diulang; store file multi-host Nonce baru; replayStore terpusat 401 / timestamp Di luar jendela waktu Jam server beda NTP; naikkan clockSkew hati-hati 422 / decrypt failed Amplop terkunci gagal dibuka AEAD key / AAD / bindHeaders beda Samakan kunci & bindHeaders 500 / sodium Ekstensi hilang Mode aead/both tanpa sodium Aktifkan ext-sodium FAQ Kenapa ditolak padahal kunci sudah benar? Path dinormalisasi beda, query order, atau body digeser proxy. Samakan canonical di kedua sisi. Aman di belakang load balancer? Ya, jika replayStore terbagi (Redis/Memcached) dan requireReplayStore aktif. Bisa tanpa enkripsi? Ya — mode hmac . Isi tetap terbaca. Response selalu HMAC? Tidak. Response mengikuti signAlg (HMAC, Ed25519 server, atau hybrid). Default replayTtl / clockSkew? 120 dan 60 detik. X-Canonical-Request untuk verify? Tidak. Hanya debug. Upgrade v3 → v4? Samakan version di kedua sisi; lihat CHANGELOG untuk wire multipart. Debug aman? CLI debug:verify dan test:roundtrip

title: Kamus Istilah
text: Kamus istilah tetap untuk tooltip. signature Segel pada amplop; jika isi berubah, segelnya rusak. encryption Mengunci isi agar hanya penerima yang bisa membuka. nonce Kode unik sekali pakai pada tiap pesan. timestamp Cap waktu pengiriman; pesan lama ditolak. replay Orang menyalin pesan sah lalu mengirimnya lagi. replay-store Buku catatan tiket (nonce) yang sudah dipakai. clock-skew Toleransi jika jam dua server tidak persis sama. key-id Rahasia yang dipakai; nomor versi kuncinya. kms Brankas untuk menyimpan & membungkus kunci. key-wrapping Menyimpan kunci di dalam kotak terkunci lain. ed25519 Pengirim punya kunci pribadi; penerima hanya kunci publik. post-quantum Persiapan menghadapi komputer kuantum di masa depan. middleware Lapisan yang memeriksa request sebelum sampai ke aplikasi. webhook Pesan otomatis dari sistem lain ke server Anda. load-balancer Pembagi lalu lintas ke beberapa server. protocol-version “Bahasa” wire yang harus sama di kedua sisi (default 4). canonical-request Bentuk baku method/path/query agar tanda tangan cocok.

title: Home
text: SecurePayload v3.2.0 Send data between servers safely It cannot be changed, read by others, or replayed. Start in 10 minutes Learn the concepts first Three protections 1 Tampering The digital seal breaks if contents change. 2 Eavesdropping Contents are locked (AEAD) in aead/both. 3 Replay One-time tickets plus a logbook. Choose a learning path A I want concepts first No code yet. Start → B I am a developer Install → Quick start. Start → C I run ops/security Warnings & checklist. Start → Who is this for? title: The Basics
text: You will learn three risks and how SecurePayload addresses them with simple analogies. Problem it solves Tampering — someone changes the body in transit. Eavesdropping — someone reads secret contents. Replay — someone resends a valid message. Fixed analogies Sealed envelope = digital signature (HMAC / Ed25519). Locked envelope = AEAD encryption (XChaCha20-Poly1305). One-time numbered ticket + date = nonce + timestamp. Ticket logbook = replay store. Key vault = KMS. Three modes Mode Plain meaning Code Sign only Seal; body may still be readable hmac Encrypt only Locked contents; no separate HMAC seal aead Both Locked + sealed (recommended) both Short flow Client builds security headers + body → server verifies using its own method/path/query → rejects if the seal breaks, decrypt fails, or the ticket was already used. ‼ Important Never trust the X-Canonical-Request header for verification. It is a debug hint only. Next: Choose Your Setup →

title: Choose Your Setup
text: Answer four questions. The result recommends mode and signing algorithm. Is the payload secret? Yes, lock it No, seal is enough May the receiver keep the same secret? Yes, shared secret OK No, prefer public keys Need sender proof (non-repudiation)? Yes, Ed25519 Not needed Many servers behind a load balancer? Yes No / single host Recommendation Mode: Signing (signAlg): Because of a load balancer, configure a shared replayStore and consider requireReplayStore . Installation → Start over Quick comparison Mode Benefit Needs hmac Seal only HMAC ≥32 chars aead Encrypt only AEAD 32-byte + sodium both Seal + encrypt Keduanya i signAlg hmac | ed25519 | hybrid-mldsa44-ed25519 — ditentukan konfigurasi server (anti-downgrade). Advanced ed25519 , hybrid PQ, deriveKeys , bindHeaders — lihat halaman Fitur.

title: Installation
text: You will install the library and check required extensions. Requirements PHP ≥ 8.0 (CI tests 8.0–8.5) ext-json , ext-hash ext-sodium required for aead / both and Ed25519 Optional: ext-curl , PSR-18, PSR-16, cloud KMS SDKs Check on your machine bash Copy php -v php -m | grep sodium Install with Composer bash Copy composer require sk8dvlpr/securepayload On success, the package appears under vendor/sk8dvlpr/securepayload . ✓ Tip Hybrid ML-DSA needs a pqSigner from your app — it is not bundled. Next: Quick Start →

title: Quick Start
text: Goal: a working both request in ≤ 10 minutes. Keys below are for tests only. Create test keys HMAC ≥ 32 chars; AEAD exactly 32 bytes (base64). Sender side buildHeadersAndBody. Receiver side verify with the server's method/path/query. Send the request X-* headers + body. Tamper test Change the body → must fail. Client example php Copy <?php use SecurePayload\SecurePayload; // TEST keys only — never use in production $hmac = str_repeat('a', 32); $aead = base64_encode(random_bytes(32)); $sp = new SecurePayload([ 'mode' => 'both', 'clientId' => 'demo', 'keyId' => 'v1', 'hmacSecretRaw' => $hmac, 'aeadKeyB64' => $aead, ]); [$headers, $body] = $sp->buildHeadersAndBody( 'https://example.test/api/orders', 'POST', ['orderId' => 1] ); Server example php Copy <?php $sp = new SecurePayload([ 'mode' => 'both', 'keyLoader' => function ($cid, $kid) use ($hmac, $aead) { return ['hmacSecret' => $hmac, 'aeadKeyB64' => $aead]; }, // multi-server: inject replayStore + requireReplayStore ]); $resul

title: Managing Keys
text: How to create keys HMAC secret: at least 32 characters . AEAD key: exactly 32 bytes , stored as base64. Ed25519: key pairs; requests use the client pair; responses use the server pair. bash Copy composer exec securepayload keys:generate Where to store Env ( EnvKeyProvider ), database ( DbKeyProvider ), or a KMS vault . ‼ Don't Do not commit keys to git, send them in chat, or log secrets. Rotation KeyManager::rotateKey() / CLI keys:rotate support a grace period ( useKeyLifecycle ). ! LocalKms Dev only. Production: Vault/AWS/GCP/Azure. Next: Features →

title: Features & Benefits
text: Pick a feature. Each page uses benefits → when → how → API. Anti-replay — Stops valid messages from being sent again. Two-way Response — Server replies with a seal bound to the request nonce. Small Files — Send small attachments in JSON (_attachment). File Streaming — Per-chunk secretstream for large files. Multipart Files — Secure manifest + ciphertext in one multipart request (wire v4). Webhooks — Verify inbound webhooks with the same rules. Ed25519 — Asymmetric signing: client private, server public. Hybrid Post-quantum — Hybrid ML-DSA44 + Ed25519 for post-quantum readiness. deriveKeys — HKDF derives per-purpose subkeys from a master key. bindHeaders — Bind critical headers into AAD so they cannot be swapped quietly. Observability — onSecurityEvent callback + Prometheus/OTel exporters. RFC 9421 — Interop bridge to HTTP Message Signatures. Node & Go SDKs — Node.js & Go SDKs follow the wire protocol (default 4). CLI — CLI for key generate/rotate and debug. mTLS — mTLS complements SecurePayload at the transport layer. KMS — Key vaults: Local, Vault, AWS, GCP, Azure. title: Warnings
text: Do ⛔ Keep protocol version identical on client & server (default 4). ⛔ Server must use its own method/path/query. ⛔ Multi-server: shared replayStore + requireReplayStore . ⛔ HTTPS in production. ⚠️ HMAC ≥ 32 chars; AEAD 32 bytes. ⚠️ deriveKeys and bindHeaders must match both sides. 💡 Response follows signAlg — not always HMAC. Don't ⛔ Do not trust X-Canonical-Request for verification. ⛔ Do not store the request Ed25519 private key on the server. ⛔ Do not log secrets / plaintext. ⚠️ Do not rely on the default file cache behind a load balancer. ⚠️ Do not use LocalKms in production. 💡 Do not assume a third-party audit exists — none yet. Production checklist Checks persist in the browser (localStorage) when available. Protocol version matches both sides HTTPS required Shared replayStore if multi-server requireReplayStore enabled for multi-server Keys from env/KMS, not hard-coded signAlg set by the server Team knows there is no third-party audit yet Reset checklist i Defaults replayTtl=120, clockSkew=60. Nonce memory window = replayTtl + clockSkew. Next: Troubleshooting →

title: Troubleshooting
text: Symptom → fix Symptom Meaning Likely cause Fix 401 / invalid signature Seal mismatch Different secret / changed body / path Match keys; check method/path/query 401 / replay detected Ticket already used Retried request; file store multi-host Fresh nonce; shared replayStore 401 / timestamp Outside time window Clock drift NTP; raise clockSkew carefully 422 / decrypt failed Locked envelope won't open AEAD key / AAD / bindHeaders mismatch Match keys & bindHeaders 500 / sodium Missing extension aead/both without sodium Enable ext-sodium FAQ Rejected even with correct keys? Normalized path differs, query order, or a proxy mutated the body. Align canonicalization. Safe behind a load balancer? Yes, with a shared replayStore (Redis/Memcached) and requireReplayStore. Without encryption? Yes — mode hmac . The body stays readable. Is response always HMAC? No. Response follows signAlg (HMAC, server Ed25519, or hybrid). Default replayTtl / clockSkew? 120 and 60 seconds. Use X-Canonical-Request to verify? No. Debug only. Upgrade v3 → v4? Match version on both sides; see CHANGELOG for multipart wire. Safe debugging? CLI debug:verify and test:roundtrip — never print secrets. Hybrid without pqSigner?

title: Glossary
text: Fixed glossary for tooltips. signature A seal on an envelope; if the contents change, the seal breaks. encryption Locking the contents so only the receiver can open them. nonce A one-time code attached to every message. timestamp The send time; old messages are rejected. replay Someone copies a valid message and sends it again. replay-store A logbook of tickets (nonces) already used. clock-skew Allowed difference between two servers' clocks. key-id The secret in use; and its version number. kms A vault that stores and wraps keys. key-wrapping Keeping a key inside another locked box. ed25519 Sender holds a private key; receiver only holds a public key. post-quantum Preparation for future quantum computers. middleware A layer that checks a request before it reaches your app. webhook An automatic message another system sends to your server. load-balancer A traffic splitter across several servers. protocol-version The wire “language” both sides must share (default 4). canonical-request A normalized method/path/query so signatures match.
